king. patron of Vācaspatimiśra (a. of C. Bhāmatī on Brahmasūtra). See D. Bhattacharya, His.. of Navya Ny. in Mithilā p. 24.

Nṛganṛpatipāṣāṇayajñayūpapraśasti
on king Vīsala (1164 A. D.) of Śākambharī. prob. from his stone, ins.

See ZDMG. XXVII. p. 101.

Nṛgamokṣa
story of king Nṛga who got released from being a lizard by the grace of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. by Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭatiri.
